svg.title: Why FluxCode vs Zed & VS Code
svg.text: Why FluxCode vs Zed & VS Code
Stacked vertically top to bottom: everyday benefit first, programmer detail next.
Opens right away with no splash screen or wait.
Stays light in the background so your laptop stays cool and fast.
1.4 MB (47.3x less than Zed, 663x less than VS Code)
Claims far less virtual memory on low-RAM laptops.
One clean app process instead of spawning a cluster of helpers.
Downloads in seconds and takes the space of a few photos.
PART 2 / BUILT-IN CAPABILITIES (OUT OF THE BOX)
Filled accent square = built in · Grey square = partial or via extension · Empty square = not available
Chat with AI right inside the editor without freezing your laptop, and undo any turn.
ACP (OpenCode 2, Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot), FIFO queue, Force Send, EcoQoS ~94% trim
Built-in agent + ACP (no live EcoQoS RAM trim or Job Object isolation)
Install your favorite icons, themes, and AI extensions from the same ecosystem.
Almost all VS Code extensions work (icons, themes, AI); report bugs in GitHub Issues
See which folders eat your storage instantly, without installing a separate tool.
Built-in Rust treemap (Ctrl+Shift+Y) + @wiztree AI context in 0-1 tool calls
Open and edit databases, PDFs, Office docs, ZIPs, and Minecraft files in one app.
Editable Bedrock/Java NBT, LevelDB, SQLite, PDF, Office, ZIP, and Hex built in
Images built in; other formats need extensions
When code fails, click the error card to jump straight to the exact broken line.
Multi-tab shell with clickable file:line:col error cards across 15+ languages
Manage commits, incoming changes, project templates, and Windows-Linux files smoothly.
Commit graph, incoming fetch, 11 built-in manifests, fast WSL2 disk helper
Built-in Git; SSH, Containers, and WSL via extensions
Does not track your habits or send usage data back to any server.
Zero telemetry (only automatic network call is the update check)
Still in active development; mature language servers and a debugger are on the roadmap.
Dev builds; LSP and debugger planned (Run supported)
Stable release with built-in LSP and debugger
Stable release with debugger and extension LSPs
Windows 11 Home (AMD Ryzen 5 7535HS, 15 GB RAM) · empty profiles · median of 5 runs · Nov 2026
